title.zh: 门头沟Mt. Gox将还款期限再次延后一年至2027年10月31日
title.en: 门头沟Mt. Gox将还款期限再次延后一年至2027年10月31日

current_state.zh: The Mt. Gox bankruptcy trustee, with court approval, extended the deadline for completing creditor repayments by one year, from October 31, 2026 to October 31, 2027.
current_state.en: The Mt. Gox bankruptcy trustee, with court approval, extended the deadline for completing creditor repayments by one year, from October 31, 2026 to October 31, 2027.
